name: Hydracept Public API
description: One API to run external AI capabilities—with durable jobs, receipts, and BYOK. Public integration surface for Hydracept capabilities and jobs. Authenticate with a Hydracept API key (Bearer). The info.version field tracks the current published Hydracept client release, not a separate HTTP API semver.
